28032-sprays-of-shamrock.title: Sprays Of Shamrock
28032-sprays-of-shamrock.creator: Unknown
28032-sprays-of-shamrock.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. of the dawn   Upsprang the chieftain and loud called his kerns,   And bade them seek the Rock. For many a day   They roved the sweeping meads and fens and fells   In fruitless search, and ever forth again   Relentlessly he drove them from his hold   Beside the dimpling waters of Lough Leane. “The Rock!” he cried, “find ye the Rock of Song!”   And still they found it not.

arxiv-2210-01490.title: Gain and phase calibration of sensor arrays from ambient noise by cross-spectral measurements fitting Preprint: Author, JASA
arxiv-2210-01490.creator: Charles Vanwynsberghe, Simon Bouley, Jérôme Antoni
arxiv-2210-01490.description: Abstract We address the problem of blind gain and phase calibration of a sensor array from ambient noise. The key motivation is to ease the calibration process by avoiding a complex procedure setup. We show that computing the sample covariance matrix in a diffuse field is sufficient to recover the complex gains.

arxiv-2210-16407.title: Just-DREAM-about-it: Figurative Language Understanding with DREAM-FLUTE
arxiv-2210-16407.creator: Yuling Gu, Yao Fu, Valentina Pyatkin, Ian Magnusson
arxiv-2210-16407.description: Abstract Figurative language (e.g., “he flew like the wind”) is challenging to understand, as it is hard to tell what implicit information is being conveyed from the surface form alone. We hypothesize that to perform this task well, the reader needs to mentally elaborate the scene being described to identify a sensible meaning of the language.

arxiv-2301-07055.title: On 𝑮 \boldsymbol{G} -birational rigidity of del Pezzo surfaces
arxiv-2301-07055.creator: Egor Yasinsky
arxiv-2301-07055.description: Abstract Abstract. Let G be a finite group and H\subseteq G be a subgroup. We prove that if a smooth del Pezzo surface over an algebraically closed field is H -birationally rigid, then it is also G -birationally rigid, answering a geometric version of Kollár’s question in dimension 2 positively.

arxiv-2310-12679.title: Landau Free Energy of small clusters beyond mean field approach
arxiv-2310-12679.creator: S. Semenov, A.N. Rubtsov
arxiv-2310-12679.description: Abstract The Landau Free Energy determines the landscape of order parameter fluctuations that occur in a physical system at thermal equilibrium and, in particular, characterizes the critical phenomena. We propose a semi-analytical approach based on the Fluctuating Local Field method, which allows to estimate Landau Free Energy for small clusters with discrete (Ising model) and continuous (Heisenberg model) order parameter.

arxiv-2405-19741.title: Teaching the apparent motion of Sun and stars across four European countries Journal: aej
arxiv-2405-19741.creator: Hans BEKAERT, Wim VAN DOOREN, Hans VAN WINCKEL, Markus POESSEL, Inge THIERING, Marco NICOLINI, Enrico ARTIOLI, Despina AVGERINOU, Eleana BALLA, Mieke DE COCK
arxiv-2405-19741.description: Abstract In the context of the European Erasmus+ project Teaching ASTronomy at the Educational level (TASTE), we investigated the extent to which a learning module at school and a set of activities during a planetarium visit help students to gain insight in the Apparent Motion of the Sun and Stars.

arxiv-2412-10760.title: Fixed Order Scheduling with Deadlines
arxiv-2412-10760.creator: André Berger, Arman Rouhani, Marc Schröder
arxiv-2412-10760.description: Abstract This paper studies a scheduling problem where machines must follow a predetermined fixed order for processing jobs. Given n n jobs, each with processing times and deadlines, we aim to minimize the number of machines used while meeting deadlines and maintaining the order.

arxiv-2509-05028.title: A complete system of inequalities for the diameter, in-, and circumradius in the 3 3 -dimensional Euclidean space Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. 52A40 ; 52A15 . This research has been funded by the PID2022-136320NB-I00 project / AEI/10.13039/501100011033/ FEDER, UE
arxiv-2509-05028.creator: René Brandenberg, Bernardo González Merino, Mia Runge
arxiv-2509-05028.description: Abstract . We present a complete system of inequalities for the inradius, circumradius, and diameter in the 3 3 -dimensional Euclidean space. To do so, we prove quasiconcavity of the inradius evaluated over n n -simplices with a common facet independently of the norm/gauge under consideration. 1.

arxiv-2511-10894.title: DINOv3 as a Frozen Encoder for CRPS-Oriented Probabilistic Rainfall Nowcasting
arxiv-2511-10894.creator: Luciano Araujo Dourado Filho, Almir Moreira da Silva Neto Anthony Miyaguchi,, Rodrigo Pereira David, Rodrigo Tripodi Calumby, Lukáš Picek
arxiv-2511-10894.description: Abstract This paper proposes a competitive and computationally efficient approach to probabilistic rainfall nowcasting. A video projector (V-JEPA Vision Transformer) associated to a lightweight probabilistic head is attached to a pre-trained satellite vision encoder (DINOv3 - SAT493M) to map encoder tokens into a discrete empirical CDF (eCDF) over 4-hour accumulated rainfall.

arxiv-2602-10509.title: Stationary periodic solutions to Nonlinear Dirac equations with non-coercive potentials Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject classification: 35A15, 35Q41, 35J50, 81Q05
arxiv-2602-10509.creator: Fuping Zhang, Ruijun Wu
arxiv-2602-10509.description:
A 2026 arXiv research paper by Fuping Zhang, Ruijun Wu. We obtain periodic solutions for nonlinear Dirac equations with a nonlinear term that is not necessarily coercive. This amounts to study the equation on a three-dimensional torus. The Palais-Smale condition is enhanced by involving a coercive perturbation. Uniform estimates for the critical levels as well as the Sobolev norms for the perturbed solutions are obtained, making it possible to pass to a limit which gives a nontrivial solution. Keywords
: nonlinear Dirac equation, periodic solution, stationary solution, linking, perturbation

1.

europmc-pmc6954236.title: PHD1 controls muscle mTORC1 in a hydroxylation-independent manner by stabilizing leucyl tRNA synthetase.

pmc-12700370.title: The impact of influencer marketing in the tourism industry: A digital marketing perspective
pmc-12700370.creator: Md. Asaduzzaman Babu, Hafsa Akter Urmi, Abzal Hosen Tofayel, Md. Mehedul Islam Sabuj, Md Tamjid Ul Alam
pmc-12700370.description: This study aims to examine how influencer marketing shapes tourists’ perceptions and purchase intentions in the tourism sector of Bangladesh. Specifically, it examines the impact of word of mouth, content characteristics, consumer trust, emotional connection, and brand awareness on consumer perception, as well as how these perceptions influence purchase intention within a digital marketing context.

pmc-12709809.title: DTMUV upregulates DDX17 expression to facilitate viral replication
pmc-12709809.creator: Yuting Cheng, Wenjing Xie, Qingkang Zhou, Chunyan Ma, Anping Wang, Zhi Wu, Wenfeng Jia, Fan Sun, Fang Zhou, Mixue Wang, Jilin Zhang, Shanyuan Zhu
pmc-12709809.description: Duck Tembusu virus (DTMUV) is a single-stranded positive-sense RNA virus that poses a serious threat to the poultry industry, and its infection mechanism remains incompletely understood. This study aimed to investigate the role of the host protein DDX17 (DEAD-box RNA helicase 17) in DTMUV infection.

pmc-12808164.title: Enhancing vehicle-mountable multiple object tracking systems with embeddable Ising machines
pmc-12808164.creator: Kosuke Tatsumura, Yohei Hamakawa, Masaya Yamasaki, Koji Oya, Hiroshi Fujimoto
pmc-12808164.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The cognitive function of tracking multiple objects, essential for autonomous mobile vehicles or autonomous robots, involves object detection and their temporal associations. While significant progress has recently been made in machine learning to elaborate the similarity matrix between the objects that have been recognized and the objects detected in the current video frame, less progress has been made on the assignment problem that ultimately determines temporal associations, which is a combinatorial optimization problem.

pmc-13199494.title: Telomere-to-telomere-level genome assembly and annotation of the Zi goose Anser cygnoides
pmc-13199494.creator: Ke Jiang, Hechuan Wang, Kexin Cong, Yunuo Liu, Jiaxin Yin, Xiaofang Ren, Zhifeng Chen, Kun Yang, Ying Zhang, Qiuju Wang, Shengjun Liu
pmc-13199494.description: This study leveraged advanced genomic sequencing technologies, including Oxford Nanopore technology long reads, Pacific Biosciences HiFi sequencing reads, BGISEQ T7 short reads, and high-throughput chromatin conformation capture technology, to demonstrate the telomere-to-telomere genome assembly and annotation of the Zi goose, a distinctive breed in the cold regions of China.

pmc-13378581.title: Glycolysis-driven immunosuppression in gastric cancer: Metabolic crosstalk between tumor cells and the immune microenvironment (Review)
pmc-13378581.creator: Bo Zhang, Lihan Shang, Ziyu Kuang, Chaoran Wang, Bingsheng Sun, Fanming Kong
pmc-13378581.description: Gastric cancer (GC) remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and only a subset of patients achieves durable benefit from immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). This suggests that non-genomic barriers within the tumor microenvironment (TME) substantially limit antitumor immunity. Increasing evidence indicates that tumor-intrinsic glycolytic reprogramming and lactate accumulation contribute to this immune resistance.

pmc-13429018.title: Comparison of quantitative light-induced fluorescence and near-infrared intraoral scanner imaging for proximal caries across predefined ICCMS radiographic thresholds: a diagnostic accuracy study
pmc-13429018.creator: Ahmad Bittar, Elif Alkan, Özlem Kanar, Bora Korkut, Dilek Tağtekin
pmc-13429018.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundProximal caries detection remains challenging because early lesions are often inaccessible to visual inspection and bitewing radiography exposes patients to ionizing radiation. Quantitative light-induced fluorescence (QLF) and near-infrared imaging integrated into intraoral scanners are proposed as non-ionizing adjuncts.

pmc-13580328.title: Efficient production of a self-amplifying RNA vaccine sequence with the single subunit RNA polymerase from Klebsiella phage 32 utilizing the native AU initiating dinucleotide
pmc-13580328.creator: Marcus A. Price, Maryia Trubitsyna, Jane E. Paget, Benjamin W. Baker, Frances Turner, Susan J. Rosser
pmc-13580328.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). RNA polymerase (RNAP) is the enzyme that produces RNA for an increasingly large variety of uses. The need for efficient industrial production of high quantities of mRNA was exemplified during the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic. While the RNAP from the T7 bacteriophage has been the gold standard for some time, it has certain limitations impeding efficient manufacturing of all RNA types, including production of long transcript self-amplifying RNA (saRNA). Here we present an alternative to T7 RNAP, identified from the Klebsiella bacteriophage 32 (KP32).

pmc-13617930.title: Nebulized magnesium sulfate reduces postoperative sore throat following general anesthesia: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and trial sequential analysis
pmc-13617930.creator: Sandara Bashir, Muhammad Mustafa Khan, Muhammad Hamad Khan, Abdul Haseeb, Abdullah Abdullah, Abdul Saboor, Habib Ur Rehman, Rayaan Jan, Aman Ullah, Hassan Khalil, Sayed Shahabuddin, Abdul Muiz, Yahya Samadi, Asiya Shahzad
pmc-13617930.description: BackgroundPost-operative sore throat (POST) frequently complicates general anesthesia involving endotracheal intubation, affecting roughly 60% of individuals and markedly hindering postoperative recovery. The current systematic review and meta-analysis assessed both the safety profile and prophylactic efficacy of preoperative magnesium sulfate administered via nebulization against POST.

uslaw-usc-t50-s4311.title: 50 U.S.C. § 4311 — Importations prohibited
uslaw-usc-t50-s4311.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t50-s4311.description: United States Code, Title 50 (War And National Defense); Chapter 53 (Trading With The Enemy). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whenever during the present war the President shall find that the public safety so requires and shall make proclamation thereof it shall be unlawful to import into the United States from any country named in such proclamation any article or articles mentioned.
